own: Yes, again with the granular checkboxes. We can have one that says you could even designate one of your team members a manager. And then we'll have to decide what are the automated checkboxes that it clicks when you decide that they're a manager. But the cool thing with it being granular, you can still actually uncheck specific boxes that it turned on automatically when they became manager. So it's more like a recommendation of what features they should have as manager, but you still ultimately get to finely customize what this person can do.
